caption:
Every new piece of information feels like progress toward a decision. It's not. It's your brain gathering evidence to avoid the discomfort of committing. The Tab Closer gives you the exit: name the two survivors, face the worst case, and pick. DM "DETOX" for the full 7-Day Overthinking Detox. Save this for your next 47-tab spiral.

#overthinking #decisionparalysis #anxiety #mentalhealth #arajournals
hook: you've researched every option and you're less sure than when you started
